verdict_reason: The paper defines each turn as arccos(<v_t,v_{t+1}>/(||v_t||||v_{t+1}||)) and each layer value as the equal-weight mean of per-sentence mean turns; src/blme/tasks/geometry/trajectory_curvature.py:72-145 implements those operations. Against the released calculation, maximum absolute angle and layer-mean errors were 4.00e-7 and 7.37e-8 (8.88e-16 against an independent direct transcription); on the unequal-length discriminator the paper and current code both gave 1.570796326794897 rad while the rejected pooled-angle formula gave 2.984513020910303 rad, and the 0, pi/2, pi, and pi/3 analytic anchors agreed to at most 4.44e-16.
comparable_reason: Across 65 unique archived runs carrying the corrected mean-of-sentence-means formula, Spearman rho with d_model/n_layers was -0.001/+0.095 for last-layer curvature, -0.120/-0.175 for overall curvature, and -0.103/-0.130 for straightening_ratio, so the headline values were not dominated by width or depth; however, on the 61 runs with matched tokenizer metadata, overall curvature versus log(vocab_size) was rho=-0.634 (p=4.10e-8), and direct resampling of the identical unit-circle path at 6 versus 60 points changed mean curvature from 72.0000 to 6.1017 degrees. Depth normalization reduced slope correlations with d_model/n_layers/log(params)/log(vocab) from +0.771/+0.818/+0.819/+0.330 to +0.366/+0.215/+0.353/+0.105 (65 runs, 62 for vocab), but it fails the required mechanism test: duplicating the final state of the feasible profile [2.1,1.7,1.6,2.0] with 20 exact identity layers left final hidden states and logits at max error 0.0 yet flipped normalized slope from -0.120 to +0.116.
normalized_variant: curvature_slope (OLS of per-layer curvature on normalized depth l/(n_layers-1))
github_reason: Fetched the authors' sent_sampling implementation at repository HEAD 32ac2715a47da9b0d35e3860f37a2a5295e41302 and executed its diff/normalize/dot/arccos and per-sentence aggregation on fresh shared inputs. BLME differed by at most 4.0048e-7 per angle and 7.3655e-8 per layer mean; the authors' mean curve_change and BLME's difference of layer means agreed to 3.7297e-16, and an independent higher-precision transcription agreed to 8.8818e-16.
paper_reason: Figure S6 reports a 119.99-degree peak for 8,408 isotropic-Gaussian trajectories in d=1,600 with 6-19 points. Running the current BLME kernel under that protocol gave mean 120.001360 degrees and KDE mode 119.997925 degrees, relative errors 9.47e-5 and 6.60e-5 respectively; the analytic high-dimensional limit arccos(-1/2) is exactly 120.000000 degrees.
confounds_reason: The principal outputs have only |rho|<=0.175 against d_model and n_layers across 65 runs, but overall curvature has rho=-0.634 with log(vocab_size) across 61 runs (p=4.10e-8), so tokenizer/family confounding is plausible rather than a confirmed width/depth proxy. A direct probe of 15 local tokenizers found 0/200 passages reaching the 512-token cap for every tokenizer and only rho=+0.205 (p=0.465) between log(vocab_size) and mean token count, refuting the proposed fixed-truncation mechanism but not the differing-token-path mechanism demonstrated by the 72.0000 versus 6.1017-degree resampling test.
defects: CONFIG: src/blme/tasks/configs/defaults.yaml:131-133 is merged into self.config and therefore effectively fixes num_samples=100 and skip_first_tokens=1; the code-level fallback cannot correct it. Of 15 locally probed tokenizer families, 9 prepend no leading special token and 6 prepend exactly one, so the same setting drops content for the former and BOS for the latter. Five exact current-code no-prefix model runs measured 0.192-0.332 degree shifts in overall curvature and 0.17%-1.89% relative shifts in straightening_ratio, with the argmin unchanged in 5/5 models.

NORMALIZED VARIANT: normalized depth removes the algebraic L-1 divisor and reduces all four measured architecture associations (+0.771/+0.818/+0.819/+0.330 to +0.366/+0.215/+0.353/+0.105), but it is not function-preserving: adding 20 identity layers to [2.1,1.7,1.6,2.0] flips curvature_slope from -0.120 to +0.116 while final hidden states and logits remain bit-identical (max absolute error 0.0).

OUTPUT COVERAGE: the paper reports Delta C_l=C_l-C_0 and the maximum drop, but src/blme/tasks/geometry/trajectory_curvature.py:231-245 emits only selected layer values, quartiles, endpoint ratio, and slope. In the exact current GPT2-XL run, first/last/minimum were 120.1349/114.2305/112.8739 degrees with the minimum at layer 43 of 47; the endpoint drop was 5.9044 degrees versus the paper-style maximum drop of 7.2610 degrees, an 18.68% understatement.

PROTOCOL: the effective run uses 100 WikiText passages, whereas the paper uses 8,408 Universal Dependencies sentences of 6-19 words. In the 15-tokenizer probe, 0/200 passages reached 512 tokens, so fixed-length truncation is not the measured explanation for rho=-0.634 with vocabulary; incomparable token boundaries and model family remain the supported caveats.
